_note: Canva /whats-new/ itself redirects unauthenticated headless access to login and static GET is Cloudflare-challenged. The public robots sitemap exposes Canva newsroom 'what's new' articles, so this single handwritten config polls those public newsroom URLs via curl_cffi Chrome impersonation. robots.txt does not disallow /newsroom/news/ or the sitemap; adapter keeps 5-8s polite_sleep.
